govern.title: Valuations
govern.text: Every property is professionally valued before we lend. Valuations must be no more than 90 days old and supported by comparable sales, and we lend against the lower of the purchase price or the valuation.

govern.title: Conflicts of interest
govern.text: Finding loans is kept separate from approving them. Any loan involving a related party needs extra review and formal sign off by our investment committee before any money is released.

govern.title: Credit approval
govern.text: Loans are approved by our credit committee, never by one person alone, and every decision is formally minuted.

govern.title: Aligned interests
govern.text: Our fund manager invests alongside our investors.
